text:
Maya (Finance): heads-up — renewal automation threw an exception for ACME Corp's private deployment renewal. Invoice generation failed and a duplicate platform fee appears on the retry. invoice id 56789
Raj (Revenue Ops): ugh, details? did the script re-apply the annual platform fee on top of the monthly charge? :thinking:
Maya (Finance): looks like it. system log shows the renewal webhook retried after a 500, then our retry handler created a second line instead of merging. snippet:
```
INVOICE 56789
- PLATFORM_FEE_ANNUAL: $12,000
- PLATFORM_FEE_ANNUAL: $12,000  <-- duplicate
- SUPPORT_TIER_STANDARD: $3,000
- USAGE_TRUEUP: $1,450
TOTAL: $28,450
```
Sophie (Account Exec): omg, customer will see 2x platform fee. Kevin is on the thread? @Kevin (Customer) can you confirm they haven't paid yet?
Kevin (Customer): not paid. they pinged yesterday, saw a higher total and paused payment. CFO asked for explanation.
Raj (Revenue Ops): ok we need a quick remediation path. options: 1) issue credit memo for duplicate line and regenerate invoice; 2) void+recreate invoice; 3) manual adjustment on their ledger. Which is fastest?
Maya (Finance): fastest is credit memo + new invoice. Void requires approval windows and will delay recognition. Also need manual override to prevent automation from re-creating on webhook replay.
Leila (Director of Finance): approve credit memo. make it look clean for the customer — add explanation line item: "automation retry duplicate platform fee - credit"
Sophie (Account Exec): I'll own customer comms. suggested message: "We found a duplicate platform fee on your renewal invoice due to an internal retry; we've issued a credit and regenerated a corrected invoice. No action required on your side." ok?
Kevin (Customer): that message works. can you confirm new invoice and credit will be reflected before the month-end close?
Maya (Finance): yes — target timeline: credit memo posted within 24 hours, regenerated invoice by EOD tomorrow, will attach corrected pdf to the customer portal. posting will include these entries:
```
CREDIT MEMO 8901
- PLATFORM_FEE_CREDIT: -$12,000
NEW INVOICE 56789-1
- PLATFORM_FEE_ANNUAL: $12,000
- SUPPORT_TIER_STANDARD: $3,000
- USAGE_TRUEUP: $1,450
TOTAL: $16,450
```
Raj (Revenue Ops): also made a ticket to stop duplicate creation: ticket #INFR-1427. patch will add idempotency on renewal webhook handler to dedupe by contract_id+renewal_id.
billing-bot: automated notification — Ticket INFR-1427 created and assigned to eng-platform. ETA: 48h.
Maya (Finance): I'll create the credit memo and flag for manual review to ensure GL posting hits platform_fee account, not a misc suspense. tagging @Leila for sign-off when the credit memo is ready.
Leila (Director of Finance): sign-off granted for the credit memo and customer-facing note. please cc me on the final email.
Sophie (Account Exec): will send the customer note after the credit is posted. will include a screenshot of the corrected invoice and brief root-cause note. :thumbsup:
Kevin (Customer): appreciated. keep me posted if anything else pops up.
Maya (Finance): follow-up tasks: 1) post credit memo 2) regenerate invoice 3) upload PDF to portal 4) confirm payment hold can be released. assigning internally now.
Raj (Revenue Ops): action owner checklist updated in ticket INFR-1427. I'll follow up with eng to expedite idempotency.
Sophie (Account Exec): thanks team. Kevin — expect updated invoice link in your portal tomorrow.
Maya (Finance): closing loop here — status will be updated in this thread after the credit posts.
